title: The Western Horseman Club
venue_description:
A Historic Amarillo Institution Reimagined

The Western Horseman Club stands as one of Amarillo's most storied entertainment venues with a history dating back to 1983. After years of decline and a closure in 2021 the venue underwent an extensive renovation and reopened in 2023 under the vision of restaurateur Rory Schepisi who also owns The Drunken Oyster and Savor. The club has been transformed into a premier destination for dining dancing and live music while maintaining its historic cowboy club character.

The Venue Experience

Located inside the Cactus Cove Inn and Suites (formerly the La Kiva Hotel) The Western Horseman Club features a classic sawdust-covered dance floor where guests can two-step the night away. The spacious interior blends the venue's historic timber and old-world charm with modern amenities and updated decor. The atmosphere captures the authentic Texas cowboy culture that made the original club famous while offering contemporary comfort and style.

Live Music Programming

The Western Horseman Club hosts live music Thursday through Saturday nights featuring a diverse range of performers from country and western to rock and blues. Monday nights are dedicated to jazz musicians adding variety to the weekly lineup. The venue is home to Amarillo's popular Wednesday night open mic series hosted by Colten Witcher drawing performers and audiences from across the region. The stage and sound system accommodate both intimate acoustic sets and full band performances.

Dining and Bar Service

The club operates as a full-service restaurant and bar offering quality steaks burgers and American cuisine. Weekend brunch service has become a popular addition featuring hearty Texas-style breakfast and lunch options. The bar serves craft cocktails beer and wine with happy hour specials running daily from 4-7 PM. The kitchen is overseen by experienced culinary professionals ensuring high-quality food to complement the entertainment.

Special Events and Private Functions

Beyond regular music nights The Western Horseman Club accommodates private events weddings and corporate functions. The venue's flexible layout and professional event staff make it suitable for gatherings of various sizes. The combination of quality food attentive service and live entertainment creates a unique event experience that captures the spirit of West Texas hospitality.

title: The 806 Coffee + Lounge
venue_description:
Amarillo's Cultural Hub on Historic Route 66

The 806 Coffee + Lounge has served as a cornerstone of Amarillo's artistic and music community since 2007. Located in the Historic Route 66 District along Southwest 6th Avenue this coffee house and performance venue has become known as the home of Amarillo's longest-running open mic night and a vital gathering place for local and traveling artists musicians and community members.

Open Mic Tradition

The 806 hosts the most extensive open mic program in Amarillo with multiple events throughout each month. Regular open mic nights occur on the 2nd and 4th Wednesday of every month welcoming musicians poets and performers of all genres and skill levels. The 3rd Wednesday features a Music Open Mic with a specific focus on musical performances while the 3rd Thursday brings Fright Night Open Mic with a unique themed atmosphere. These events have launched careers and provided a supportive environment for emerging artists for nearly two decades.

Jazz Scene and Jam Sessions

The venue plays a significant role in Amarillo's thriving jazz community hosting monthly jazz jam sessions led by Austin Brazille and other local jazz educators. These sessions bring together students from Amarillo College West Texas A&M University and professional musicians creating an intergenerational learning environment. The jam sessions have become an integral part of the city's jazz culture connecting performers across different skill levels and backgrounds.

Art and Community Events

Beyond music The 806 serves as an art gallery showcasing works from local artists with monthly rotating exhibitions. The venue participates in First Thursday events in the Route 66 District featuring art openings and receptions at 7 PM followed by live music at 9 PM. The space includes vintage furniture and contemporary art creating an atmosphere that is both comfortable and inspiring. Monthly art walks poetry slams and community gatherings make The 806 a true community center.

Food Beverage and Atmosphere

The 806 specializes in fair-trade and organic coffees and teas alongside all-natural beverages including house-made soft drinks and chai. The entirely vegetarian menu features many vegan options such as the famous vegan chili hummus blue corn nachos bagel pizzas and freshly-baked goods including espresso brownies scones and muffins. The venue offers craft beers ales and wines selected for quality and value. Hours extend late into the evening making it a destination for night owls and artists working into the small hours.

title: Shark Beach
venue_description:
Island Vibes in the Texas Panhandle

Shark Beach stands out as Amarillo's most unique entertainment venue bringing genuine beach atmosphere to the High Plains of Texas. Featuring real sand a massive outdoor stage and island-inspired decor this one-of-a-kind destination combines great food live music and a relaxed coastal vibe. Originally established as Grams Burger Farm in 2008 the venue was reimagined and reopened in 2020 by the family who brought their South Padre Island experience to create Amarillo's only beachfront venue.

Summer Music Season

Shark Beach operates an extensive summer music season from May through October featuring over 100 live music nights each year. The programming includes free live music nights every Friday showcasing local bands from Amarillo and the surrounding Texas Panhandle region. Ticketed tribute concerts occur regularly featuring professional tribute acts honoring music legends from classic rock pop and country. The venue has hosted tributes to Kiss Van Halen Def Leppard The Eagles and many other iconic artists.

Open Mic and Karaoke

Throughout the music season Shark Beach hosts weekly karaoke nights typically on Thursdays offering guests the chance to perform under the stars in a supportive beach atmosphere. Open mic nights provide local musicians and performers opportunities to showcase original music and covers. The family-friendly events encourage participation from performers of all ages and skill levels. The outdoor stage setup includes professional sound equipment and lighting creating a quality performance environment.

Venue Capacity and Features

The outdoor venue can accommodate up to 2500 guests for ticketed concerts while maintaining an intimate feel for smaller events. Genuine sand covers the ground creating an authentic beach experience where guests remove their shoes and relax. Volleyball courts provide entertainment between sets. The venue encourages guests to bring fold-up chairs and features both covered areas and open-air spaces. No outside food or beverages are permitted but the venue provides quality food and drink options.

Food and Beverage Service

The burger menu features classic third-pound beef patties on fresh bakery buns with quality toppings. Hand-cut fries are made fresh and seasoned to perfection. The menu has expanded to include cheese curds and various specialty items. Mixed beverages and beer service provides refreshment during shows. The cherry limeade has earned local acclaim. Service operates from a central building with outdoor serving windows accommodating the beach setting.

Community and Events

Beyond music Shark Beach hosts special events including Sandcastle Days and other community gatherings. The venue actively supports military members and first responders. A gift shop sells ice cream Shark Beach merchandise and locally-themed apparel. The venue has become a popular photo destination with surfboard props and beach decorations. After visiting nearby Palo Duro Canyon State Park many visitors stop at Shark Beach to relax and enjoy the unique atmosphere.

title: The Lumberyard
venue_description:
Canyon's Premier Entertainment Destination

The Lumberyard represents a significant investment in the growth and cultural development of Canyon Texas located just 20 minutes south of downtown Amarillo. Opening its concert venue in May 2024 and restaurant in March 2025 this modern facility has quickly established itself as a premier destination for major concerts intimate performances and quality dining in the Texas Panhandle region.

Concert Venue and Programming

The outdoor concert space has hosted major touring acts including Josh Abbott Band Casey Donahew Midland George Thorogood and The Destroyers and Loverboy among others. The venue specializes in Texas country Red Dirt Americana indie rock and stand-up comedy with a relaxed West Texas atmosphere that puts audiences close to the performers. The First United Bank Stage features professional sound equipment and lighting with excellent acoustics and clear sightlines throughout the venue.

Weekly Live Music and Karaoke

Beyond headlining concerts The Lumberyard maintains a regular schedule of live music on Friday nights featuring regional and local acts. Thursday nights are dedicated to karaoke providing community members an opportunity to perform in a professional venue setting. The combination of ticketed concerts and free weekly events makes The Lumberyard accessible to a broad audience while maintaining high production standards.

Restaurant and Bar

The restaurant features a diverse menu with items ranging from Philly cheesesteaks to Korean BBQ egg rolls and pretzel bites alongside traditional American fare. The 36000 square-foot patio provides outdoor dining with views of the stage area. A distinctive wall of self-serve beer taps offers variety and convenience for guests. The kitchen operates with updated hours to better serve the community providing both casual dining and special event catering.

Banquet and Event Facilities

The property includes a 4000 square-foot main building renovated to serve as a banquet hall connected to a large quonset barn dining area. These spaces can accommodate up to 3300 guests for weddings meetings expos and other private events. The combination of indoor and outdoor spaces provides flexibility for events of various sizes and types throughout the year.

Community Impact and Vision

The Lumberyard represents the vision of Danny Byrd who purchased the former lumberyard property and transformed it into a community gathering space. The project has become a catalyst for Canyon's growth providing jobs supporting local businesses and creating a vibrant cultural venue. The Canyon Economic Development Corporation recognizes The Lumberyard as a key element in the city's ongoing revitalization while preserving the community's unique character and charm.
